outcome.statement: Help a member find and save one useful learning note in under two minutes.
outcome.first_useful_moment: A member can open a published note and see its saved state.

acceptance_criteria: A member can browse published notes from the home route.
A member can open one published note and see its ordered content.
A member can save and refresh the note without losing the saved state.
forbidden_changes: Do not expose protected content through direct client reads.
Do not add payment or live-streaming infrastructure in V1.
Do not begin implementation before the issue contract is accepted.

complexity.label: M
complexity.rationale: A reader flow crosses content, authorization, and persistence boundaries.

risk_map.impact: The first useful moment must stay narrow.
risk_map.mitigation: Keep the V1 outcome to one browse-open-save path.

risk_map.impact: Owner and member roles may be mis-bound.
risk_map.mitigation: Verify role and account association in a read-only investigation.

risk_map.impact: Protected content must not be client-readable.
risk_map.mitigation: Use a server-authorized page-facing service boundary.

risk_map.impact: Ordered content can drift between mock and target.
risk_map.mitigation: Bind the reader contract to a versioned package receipt.
Reserve a later device acceptance matrix.

risk_map.impact: Review and formal release are separate claims.
risk_map.mitigation: Keep platform read-back as a later human gate.

risk_map.impact: Existing note identities may need preservation.
risk_map.mitigation: Defer migration unless the accepted V1 outcome requires it.

solution_search.query: ordered content reader with protected member state
solution_search.finding: Existing local reader patterns cover ordered blocks but not authorization.

solution_search.query: WeChat Mini Program CloudBase shipping workflow
solution_search.finding: The shipping skill provides platform and evidence boundaries.

ordered_work.outcome: A member can browse, open, and save one published note.
acceptance_criteria: The home route lists published notes.
The reader preserves the declared content order.
The save action is server-authorized and survives refresh.
